intent.rationale: Write on clk_w and read on clk_r of the same entry; result is implementation dependent.

labels.note: Read port on clk_r reads a memory written on the unrelated clk_w with no collision handling; a read during a write is undefined in hardware though simulation returns a definite value.
Write on clk_w and registered read on clk_r: a same-address read during write across clocks returns implementation-dependent data, and whether it happens depends on the external address discipline.

settlement.note: Write on clk_w and registered read on unrelated clk_r give an implementation-dependent result on a same-address collision, but both addresses and we are free input ports, so only the environment decides whether a collision occurs.
